詞／曲：長澤崇史（Takafumi Nagasawa）
中文翻譯：黃川寧

lines.b: I pour my life for You
You are all that I need
Let You be all that I yearn

lines.a: 我心滿溢 我心滿溢
lines.b: My heart is full, my heart is filled

lines.a: 對祢的愛和思念無止盡
lines.b: With love and desire for You till eternity

lines.a: 讓我走向祢的身旁貼近祢
lines.b: Draw me near to Your side

lines.a: 主啊 我渴慕尋求祢
lines.b: O Lord, I long for You

lines.a: 讓我走向祢的身旁貼近祢
lines.b: Draw me near to Your side

lines.a: 主啊 我渴慕尋求祢
lines.b: O Lord, I long for You
